Silicon Microgravity Ltd. (SMG) is a UK based SME spin-out of Cambridge University that leads in high-precision MEMS inertial and gravity sensors, delivering unmatched accuracy, compact design, and low power consumption. Our resonant MEMS technology surpasses conventional solutions, driving advancements in autonomous navigation, space, aerospace, and subsurface exploration. Backed by over a decade of research and a growing patent portfolio, SMG is redefining motion and gravity sensing for the future.

For inertial navigation, SMG Motion develops high-performance, next generation MEMS sensors for inertial navigation, tilt sensing, and seismology. SMG offers low drift, low noise, high accuracy and sensitivity accelerometers and gyroscopes manufactured in silicon utilising our resonant MEMS technology. These take MEMS technology into the navigation grade arena with the potential to displace larger and more costly FOGs. Focus market segments for applications include Space and Aerospace.

For gravity sensing, SMG Gravity has developed as prototype gravity sensor for surface applications which has a sensitivity of 10 nano-g. The sensor has a form factor and power consumption which makes it suitable for deployment in space and the company has provided quotes for lunar missions.

Since 1980, Veiligheidstechniek Nederland B.V. (VTN) has been supplying and maintaining high-quality personal protective equipment that enhances the safety of people in hazardous work situations and environments. We can rightfully call ourselves a leading total supplier for industry, defense, fire departments and police, in the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany, among others.

VTN offers a wide range of personal protective equipment for several markets. Our range includes portable gas detection from BW Honeywell and Blackline Safety, fixed gas detection from Honeywell Analytics, Bacharach, and Oldham Teledyne, and breathing apparatus from Scott 3M. Also, we supply protective clothing and gloves from Ansell, thermal imaging cameras from Bullard and Seek, and high-pressure compressed air compressors from L&W. We are also a certified service partner for these products.
We also represent renowned brands such as JSP Safety, Gumotex (emergency tents), Besto (life jackets), Viking Diving, Miele Professional, Toptrock, and Harstra (cleaning and drying equipment).

In addition to our representations, we produce and develop custom-made breathing air units and air trolleys in-house for the EMEA region. These products bear the CE mark and are approved by SIR and TÜV Nord. With a focus on innovation and product development, we strive to realize solutions together with our customers that fully meet their needs.

In addition to the production and supply of high-quality personal protective equipment, we place great value on the quality of our service within our organization. VTN has its own mobile service team for the Netherlands and Flanders, as well as several well-equipped, manufacturer-certified service workshops for the repair and maintenance of, among other things, portable gas detection equipment, breathing apparatus, diving suits, gastight suits, and compressed air units. Furthermore, our technicians perform preventive maintenance and repairs on-site at the end user's location on items including compressors, compressed air systems, portable and fixed gas detection equipment, and compressed air units and trolleys.

Our team of over 50 specialists is ready to provide you with personalized, tailored advice and service!

Polymat Composites is an innovative Italian startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Tione di Trento, Italy. The company specializes in the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced composite materials, utilizing high-performance technical fibers such as carbon, aramid, and basalt. Innovation, quality, and technological excellence are at the core of its business philosophy.
One of Polymat’s key strengths is represented by the Basax® brand, which identifies environmentally sustainable composite materials manufactured using 100% natural basalt fibers and bio-based resin systems derived from renewable sources, with approximately 87% plant-based content. These materials provide a sustainable alternative to traditional fiberglass composites while ensuring excellent mechanical performance, lightweight properties, durability, and long-term reliability.
Polymat Composites operates across several strategic industries, including automotive, aerospace, light aviation and unmanned aerial systems (UAS/UAVs), industrial robotics, defense, sports equipment, design and furniture, as well as the production and supply of semi-finished composite components. Thanks to its integrated approach, the company independently manages the entire production chain in-house, from concept development to final manufacturing, through a wide range of specialized departments. These include research and development, engineering and technical design, rapid prototyping, resin infusion, hand lay-up lamination, autoclave processing, and additive manufacturing technologies for specific applications.
Polymat’s manufacturing processes are distinguished by a strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. The company implements advanced production methodologies aimed at minimizing material waste and promoting the internal reuse of residual materials whenever possible. Furthermore, Polymat continuously invests in innovative technologies and advanced systems to improve operational efficiency and optimize energy consumption throughout its facilities.
Driven by an ethical business approach that places environmental stewardship and local value creation at its core, Polymat Composites is committed to delivering solutions that meet the highest standards of quality, performance, and reliability. The company addresses the growing demand for high-performance products that combine technological excellence with environmental responsibility. Its mission is to become a recognized reference point in the advanced composites industry by integrating performance, aesthetics, and sustainability within a business model fully aligned with the principles of the circular economy.

Meneltir is a single entity company incorporated in Malta. It is a wholly independent entity and is not part of a group or other corporate structure. Its shareholders are private individuals, not ordinarily resident in Malta. Regardless, the Company's management is centred on Malta and its Board meetings take place in Malta. Any dividends distributed to shareholders in the future will be paid in Malta subject to the Maltese tax code and due approval of the Company's Board of Directors acting under Maltese company law. 

Meneltir Labs is building an end-to-end atmospheric intelligence system, coupling orbital sensing, AI-native modelling, and operational delivery into a single integrated architecture. Operating from Malta, our mission is to build an AI-native orbital platform; deliver high-cadence atmospheric observations from a constellation designed for on-orbit inference; enable AI-native atmospheric modelling on a neural architecture trained on decades of reanalysis data; produce probabilistic forecast fields with calibrated uncertainty rather than point predictions or ensemble means; and provide sector-specific risk quantification through a unified API.
Building on this atmospheric intelligence stack, Meneltir is developing a parametric insurance and climate-risk platform. Calibrated probabilistic forecasts and event-level hazard quantification are translated into structured risk signals for the insurance, reinsurance, and financial sectors — supporting parametric triggers, automated loss-event detection, and portfolio-level exposure analytics. This connects Meneltir's orbital and modelling layers directly to the decisions and capital flows of risk carriers, closing the loop from observation to underwriting.

solva supports companies, farmers, and industry stakeholders in Europe to deploy photovoltaics in an economically and operationally efficient manner.
Planning cost is reduced by up to 80% and field management, AI paired with advanced satellite and spatial data to unlock new synergies between traditional landuse, industry and solar energy. Photon-IV Inc. is a Canadian deep-tech defence and telecommunications company headquartered in Cambridge, Ontario. The company develops AI-driven predictive orchestration software for satellite-terrestrial (TN-NTN) network integration, addressing operational challenges in handover continuity, multi-orbit coordination, and resilient connectivity in contested or remote environments.
Photon-IV's technical focus sits at the intersection of O-RAN, non-terrestrial networks, and applied machine learning. The company has developed a proprietary AI orchestration platform built on a Temporal Fusion Transformer architecture. Current model performance: RSRP prediction Mean Absolute Error of 2.34 dBm and P50 inference latency of 20.9 milliseconds, both validated against third-party benchmarks.
The company's product portfolio includes four lines:
- Stellarlink, an O-RAN xApp for AI-driven TN-NTN handover orchestration (TRL 6)
- Predict, an rApp for IoT-NTN battery and connectivity optimization (TRL 5)
- SwarmNet, a resilient AI-orchestrated mesh communications layer for autonomous and unmanned platforms (TRL 4)
- Spectra, an extensible AI xApp and rApp framework for future 6G architectures (TRL 3)
Photon-IV holds multiple US provisional patents filed in March 2026, covering O-RAN broadband handover, IoT-NTN battery optimization, and defence uncrewed systems handover. 
The company participated in the O-RAN Alliance international plugfest at Virginia Tech, where its xApp underwent third-party validation in partnership with Keysight Technologies. Photon-IV is the only Canadian company on the published participant list for this round.
Active programmes include a Canadian Department of National Defence IDEaS contract (CW2428540), with Milestone 1 delivered and advancement to Milestone 2 confirmed. The company holds an active partnership and sandbox arrangement with Calian Group, is engaged with TerreStar Solutions on a joint Memorandum of Understanding for defence-validated orchestration on the Canadian sovereign MSS network, and has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Arctic Space Technologies (Sweden). Photon-IV is also co-developing a counter-UAS drone swarm defence solution with Telecard (Ukraine) under the NATO BRAVE programme.
Photon-IV holds Controlled Goods Program registration and Reliability Status clearance for defence work in Canada. The company is a Creative Destruction Lab alumnus and a Velocity (University of Waterloo) partner. Technical leadership includes the Chief Wireless Architect, Chief AI Architect, and Lead AI Engineer, supported by an applied engineering team and co-op researchers from leading Canadian universities.
The company's strategic priority for ESA engagement is the integration of its AI orchestration platform into European NTN and 6G research and commercial trials, with active applications submitted to the ESA-GSMA Foundry 2026 challenges on AI for NTN (Project ORION) and 6G Innovation (Project NOVA).
